1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Offline SIP identity boundary processor (PROTOCOL.md, revision 1).
     3	
     4	Reads one JSON object describing a batch of jobs from stdin and writes one
     5	JSON object holding one decision per job to stdout.  Everything is computed
     6	from the trusted directory/account/gateway context plus the (untrusted) SIP
     7	request text; no network or other external input is used.
     8	"""
     9	
    10	import json
    11	import os
    12	import re
    13	import string
    14	import sys
    15	
    16	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    17	# constants and character classes
    18	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    19	
    20	ANON = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"
    21	MAX_TEXT = 32768
    22	MAX_LINES = 512
    23	MAX_FIELDS = 128
    24	MAX_CSEQ = 2147483647
    25	
    26	_LET = string.ascii_letters
    27	_DIG = string.digits
    28	TOKEN_CHARS = frozenset(_LET + _DIG + "-.!%*_+`'~")
    29	USER_CHARS = frozenset(_LET + _DIG + "-_.!~*'()+")
    30	HOST_CHARS = frozenset(_LET + _DIG + "-.")
    31	ALNUM = frozenset(_LET + _DIG)
    32	HEX = frozenset("0123456789abcdefABCDEF")
    33	DEC = frozenset(_DIG)
    34	WSP = " \t"
    35	
    36	_T = r"[A-Za-z0-9\-\.!%*_\+`'~]"
    37	RE_NAME = re.compile("(" + _T + r"+)[ \t]*:")
    38	RE_DISPLAY = re.compile(r"(?:" + _T + r"+(?:[ \t]+" + _T + r"+)*)?[ \t]*\Z")
    39	RE_CALLID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.@+\-]{1,128}\Z")
    40	RE_CSEQ = re.compile(r"([0-9]+)[ \t]+([^ \t]+)\Z")
    41	RE_BAD = re.compile(r"[^\t\r\n -~]")
    42	
    43	COMPACT = {
    44	    "f": "from",
    45	    "t": "to",
    46	    "i": "call-id",
    47	    "l": "content-length",
    48	    "c": "content-type",
    49	}
    50	SINGLETONS = frozenset((
    51	    "from", "to", "call-id", "cseq", "content-length",
    52	    "p-preferred-identity", "remote-party-id", "privacy", "content-type",
    53	))

    56	class Reject(Exception):
    57	    """A job-level decision with a fixed reason string."""
    58	
    59	    __slots__ = ("reason",)
    60	
    61	    def __init__(self, reason):
    62	        Exception.__init__(self, reason)
    63	        self.reason = reason

    67	# URI parsing / normalization
    68	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    70	def _norm_host(host):
    71	    """Validate a DNS host and return its canonical lowercase form."""
    72	    core = host[:-1] if host.endswith(".") else host
    73	    if not core or len(core) > 253:
    74	        raise Reject("syntax")
    75	    for label in core.split("."):
    76	        if not 1 <= len(label) <= 63:
    77	            raise Reject("syntax")
    78	        if label[0] not in ALNUM or label[-1] not in ALNUM:
    79	            raise Reject("syntax")
    80	    return core.lower()
    81

    83	def _parse_sip(text, pos):
    84	    n = len(text)
    85	    out = []
    86	    i = pos
    87	    while i < n:
    88	        ch = text[i]
    89	        if ch in USER_CHARS:
    90	            out.append(ch)
    91	            i += 1
    92	        elif ch == "%":
    93	            if i + 3 > n or text[i + 1] not in HEX or text[i + 2] not in HEX:
    94	                raise Reject("syntax")
    95	            dec = chr(int(text[i + 1:i + 3], 16))
    96	            if dec not in USER_CHARS:
    97	                raise Reject("syntax")
    98	            out.append(dec)
    99	            i += 3
   100	        else:
   101	            break
   102	    if i == pos:
   103	        raise Reject("syntax")
   104	    if i >= n or text[i] != "@":
   105	        raise Reject("syntax")
   106	    i += 1
   107	    start = i
   108	    while i < n and text[i] in HOST_CHARS:
   109	        i += 1
   110	    if i == start:
   111	        raise Reject("syntax")
   112	    return "sip:" + "".join(out) + "@" + _norm_host(text[start:i]), i
